```{r mom average}

compile <- function(table_list) {
  result_list <- lapply(table_list, function(data) {
    # Calculate mean and convert to data.table for each table in the list
    data <- merge(data, fama5_data[, .(monthYear, rf)],
                  by = "monthYear", all.x = TRUE)
    
    temp <- data %>%
      select(-monthYear) %>%
      mutate(across(everything(), ~ . - rf)) %>% 
      mutate(topbottom = top20 - bottom20) %>% 
      select(-rf) %>% 
      summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
      as.data.table()
    
    return(temp)
  })
  
  # Combine the rows of all data.tables in the result_list using rbindlist
  result <- rbindlist(result_list)
  
  return(result)
}

# Assuming you have the list of tables 'table_list' available
# Call the function and pass the list of tables as an argument
result <- compile(table_list)

```


```{r regression}

# Function to compile regression results
compile_regression_results <- function(data) {
  data[, names(data) := lapply(.SD, function(x) replace(x, x == 0, NA)), .SDcols = names(data)]
  
  data <- merge(data, fama5_data[, .(monthYear, mktrf, rf, smb, hml)], by = "monthYear", all.x = TRUE)
  
  data <- data %>% 
    mutate(topminusbottom = top20 - bottom20 - rf) %>%
    as.data.table()
  
  model <- lm(topminusbottom ~ mktrf + smb + hml, data = data)
  
  coefficients <- summary(model)$coefficients[, "Estimate"]
  std_errors <- summary(model)$coefficients[, "Std. Error"]
  adjusted_r_squared <- summary(model)$adj.r.squared
  
  # Combine coefficients, standard errors, and adjusted R-squared into a data.table
  regression_table <- data.table(Coefficient = coefficients, `Standard Error` = std_errors, `Adjusted R-squared` = adjusted_r_squared)
  
  return(regression_table)
}

# Assuming you have the list of tables 'table_list' available
# Create an empty list to store the results
regression_results_list <- list()

# Loop through each table in the 'table_list' and apply the function to compile regression results
for (data in table_list) {
  regression_result <- compile_regression_results(data)
  regression_results_list <- c(regression_results_list, list(regression_result))
}

# Combine the results for all tables into a single data.table using rbindlist
final_regression_results <- rbindlist(regression_results_list)

```

```{r reg test}

reg_fama <- mom_ret_F12H12 %>% 
  as.data.table()

reg_fama[, names(reg_fama) := lapply(.SD, function(x) replace(x, x == 0, NA)), .SDcols = names(reg_fama)]

reg_fama <- merge(reg_fama, fama5_data[, .(monthYear, mktrf, rf, smb, hml)],
                  by = "monthYear", all.x = TRUE)

reg_fama <- reg_fama %>% 
  mutate(topminusbottom = top20 - bottom20 - rf) %>%
  as.data.table()

# Perform one-sample t-test on the 'topminusbottom' variable
coefficient_test <- t.test(reg_fama$topminusbottom, mu = 0)

# Check the p-value to determine significance
p_value <- coefficient_test$p.value

# Convert p-value to significance codes
signif_codes <- symnum(p_value, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE,
                       cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1),
                       symbols = c("***", "**", "*", ".", " "))

if (p_value < 0.05) {
  # The 'topminusbottom' variable is significantly different from zero
  print(paste("The 'topminusbottom' variable is significantly different from zero. Significance code:", signif_codes))
} else {
  # The 'topminusbottom' variable is not significantly different from zero
  print(paste("The 'topminusbottom' variable is not significantly different from zero. Significance code:", signif_codes))
}


```

generate_cumulative_plot <- function(data) {
  temp <- data %>%
    select(monthYear, top20, bottom20) %>% 
    mutate(momret = top20 - bottom20) %>% 
    select(-c(top20, bottom20)) %>% 
    as.data.table()

  temp <- merge(temp, sp_data[, .(monthYear, change)], by = "monthYear", all.x = TRUE)

  # Convert monthYear to a proper date format
  temp$monthYear <- as.Date(paste0(temp$monthYear, "-25"))

  # Calculate the cumulative performance for each variable
  temp <- temp %>%
    arrange(monthYear) %>%
    mutate(cumulative_change = cumprod(1 + change) * 100,
           cumulative_momret = cumprod(1 + momret) * 100) %>% 
    as.data.table()

  # Plot the cumulative performance
  plot <- ggplot(temp, aes(x = monthYear)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = cumulative_change, color = "FTSE 100")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = cumulative_momret, color = "ESG Momentum")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Variable") +
    theme_minimal() +
    guides(color = FALSE) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(70, 270))  # Set the y-axis limits to [70, 210] #210 for ftse

  return(plot)
}


cum_F3H12 <- generate_cumulative_plot(mom_ret_F3H12)
cum_F3H3 <- generate_cumulative_plot(mom_ret_F3H3)
cum_F3H6 <- generate_cumulative_plot(mom_ret_F3H6)

cum_F6H6 <- generate_cumulative_plot(mom_ret_F6H6)

cum_F12H3 <- generate_cumulative_plot(mom_ret_F12H3)
cum_F12H6 <- generate_cumulative_plot(mom_ret_F12H6)

# Combine the plots into a 3x3 grid

grid <- grid.arrange(
  cum_F3H3, cum_F3H6, cum_F3H12,
  cum_F6H3, cum_F6H6,cum_F6H12,
  cum_F12H3, cum_F12H6, cum_F12H12,
  ncol = 3)

rm(cum_F3H3, cum_F3H6, cum_F3H12,
   cum_F6H3, cum_F6H6,cum_F6H12,
   cum_F12H3, cum_F12H6, cum_F12H12)

plot(grid, xlim = c(80, 210), ylim = c(80, 210))
